propositions: Empty file_impact value is ambiguous between 'author forgot to declare' and 'legitimately no file impact'; a third explicit state is required to distinguish these cases.

The FILE_IMPACT event payload must gain optional file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason keys, with reducer state deriving tri-state (undeclared/paths/none) from file_impact presence and scope declaration.

CLI set-file-impact command must migrate from fixed-arity _REGISTRY to variadic _ARGV_REGISTRY to support both JSON array form (unchanged) and new --none flag with mandatory non-empty reason (minimum 10 non-whitespace characters).

A new library function get_file_impact_scope and MCP tool declare_no_file_impact must expose the tri-state with identical reason validation and write behavior as the CLI, returning kind/reason/paths structure.

Existing get-file-impact output and next_batch behavior remain unchanged; show command surfaces new reducer state keys; reason validation enforces minimum 10 non-whitespace chars with explicit error messaging.
